deviations.description: Copy both loop guards verbatim in shape ... and a stop_hook_active escape so hooks cannot call hooks
deviations.reason: subagent-postflight.sh's own stop_hook_active check reads that field FROM THE MARKER, whose only writer (skill_create_postflight_marker) always sets it to the literal false -- confirmed vestigial/dead by its own doc comment ('retained as false ... not by deliberate design'). This hook instead reads stop_hook_active from hook STDIN, Claude Code's own live, harness-maintained flag for exactly this purpose (true when a Stop event is itself the product of a previous Stop hook's block decision) -- functionally equivalent intent, wired to the mechanism that can actually be true.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered -- stop_hook_active read from hook stdin, the live native signal, rather than from the marker's own vestigial field; see the hook's own header comment for the full reasoning)*
